Redwood General Contractors
May 29, 2026
City of Riverside
Re: Maple Ridge Elementary Gym Addition - Change Order 038
Dear City of Riverside,
Reason for change: Owner-requested scope change. At the owner's request, additional scope was added. Work
covers rebar, #5 grade 60 and fire-rated door and hardware.
The priced items are listed below.
Ite m | Description | Qty | Unit | Unit Price | Amount
1 | Rebar, #5 grade 60 | 2,181 | LB | $1.25 | $2,726.25
2 | Fire-rated door and hardware | 5 | EA | $1,803.67 | $9,018.35
3 | Frame additional interior partition | 35 | LF | $40.80 | $1,428.00
4 | Crane rental | 1 | DAY | $2,453.77 | $2,453.77
The subtotal is $15,626.37. With 10% overhead and profit ($1,562.64), the total of this change order comes to $17,189.01.
Change in contract time: 3 calendar days.
Current status: Pending.
Owner acceptance: ______________________
Sincerely,
Redwood General Contractors
Redwood General Contractors - confidential Page 1
